Hi.
I ordered a set of dishes from your company weeks ago, but I haven't received the order yet.
My order number is 785.
I'm really sorry, but the dishes you ordered were out of stock, but it looks like we'll be getting a new shipment tomorrow.
Oh, no.
I really wanted to use them for a dinner party I'm having this weekend.
Well, today's only Tuesday.
I'll make sure that the dishes are sent out as soon as they arrive.
They should arrive in time for your dinner party.

嗯，今天才周二。
我会确保这些餐具一到就会发出。
它们应该能赶上您的晚宴。
